title: Welcome to Sports Space!
author: Abdul Maalik
excerpt: Your go-to source for breaking sports news, analysis, and insider stories.
body: Welcome to **Sports Space** — the new home for sports journalism. Here's what you can expect: Breaking news from every major league, In-depth analysis and features, Exclusive interviews with athletes and coaches, Opinion pieces from our expert team.

title: Mega trade shakes up the league
author: Marc Stein
excerpt: In a blockbuster 5-team deal, the reigning scoring champion heads to the Lakers.
body: The NBA was rocked today by a massive 5-team trade that sends the reigning scoring champion to the Los Angeles Lakers. The deal involves 12 players and 4 draft picks.

title: Champions League: Underdogs stun favourites
author: Sam Lee
excerpt: Late drama at the Bernabéu as the visitors snatch a last-minute winner.
body: In a stunning upset, the underdogs defeated the tournament favourites with a goal in the 89th minute. The victory secures their place in the semi-finals.

title: Rookie sensation drops 40 points in playoff debut
author: Shams C.
excerpt: The 19-year-old phenom broke franchise records with an unforgettable performance.
body: The rookie guard put on a show in his first playoff game, scoring 40 points with 8 assists and 5 rebounds. He becomes the youngest player in NBA history to score 40 in a playoff debut.

title: No-hitter bid ends in 9th, but pitcher makes history
author: Jeff P.
excerpt: The young ace struck out 14 and carried a no-hitter into the final inning.
body: Despite losing the no-hitter with two outs in the 9th, the 24-year-old pitcher set a new franchise record with 14 strikeouts. He's now the frontrunner for the Cy Young award.

title: Formula 1: New regulation changes set to shake up grid
author: Lawrence Barretto
excerpt: From engine rules to aero packages, the 2026 season promises the biggest technical shift.
body: The FIA has announced sweeping changes to F1 regulations for the 2026 season. The new rules focus on sustainability and closer racing, with active aerodynamics and a new power unit formula.
